translation.name: Fúka Moodaanaki Kira Ufa Afaqínaasa Ufa

content: Kainasa Abeerasa ufa.
Adamafa narí anaaqa Eewana faqa aana numasoofanoo amuaqu qaikinoo faiqi maqaseenoo mina auqu Kainafee qinau. Maqaseenoo Eewafa qinau, Anutufa dadaaqifaqa qinee faiqi akoonaiqi maqeeqa.
Kafaa mariufanoo faiqi moo maqaseenoo mina auqu Abeeranee qinau. Abeerafa innooqafinoo kooqikinaa aandausaa rakisirafa marinau. Mina afasaafa Kainafa innooqafinoo afuqakina ainaini marufa marinau.
Mariufanoo moo kari Kainafa narí afuqakinaa ainaina maraseeoo Anutuna tatufirana suqa aminau.

Abeerafa mifa faqa Anutuna tatufu amiraree qimaseenoo narí firimaru aandausakinaana ooqasaa maqarana afaaqafaqaana aruseenoo amiqira afaaqa kai tatufirana suqa aminau. Abeerana tatufirana Anutufa qafeenoo amiqira fee qimasee asasinau.
Kafaa Kainaindi qafamasee minnisanau. Kainafa mina qafoofanoo firaqoo arana qoofanoo oori runinau.
Anutufa Kainana qafamaseenoo qimaminau, nanaree ani arana qaidanoo fee. Nanaree ani oori mianni qumidanoo fee.
Anee amiqira ainaina auqeenanau asasa mianaiqini. Anee mandainaina auqaannanara numoo fannoo ani kooqiki ani amaara usinoo maridanoo. Mifa ani rafaaqa firarinana anee mina uraaqaraa.
Miqi qimasoofanoo Kainafa narí akaqa Abeerana qimaminoo qinau. Aninaqa aana fua. Miqanda moosaa oonureeqa Kainafa narí akaqa Abeerana kuqa arinau.
Arusoofanoo Anutufa Kaina iramirinoo qinau, ani akaqa Abeerafa yaifee maridanoo fee. Qufanoo Kainafa qinau, Abee qinee sia iridaqa, anee qiniara narí akaqasaa rakisimarifee fee qidanee.
Anutufa mina iriseenoo qinau. Kaina anee nanee mareenee. Anee iria, aneenna akaqa fidika maqasaa teeqiananoo. Mi fidikafa mina akiiqara iannee qimasee maqakiqari qini daaraifaqa iriqa.

Anee aneenna akaqa fidika maa maqanasaa teeqiananoo maqa qoo raqafinaki ani akaqa fidika minaki keeqeenoo. Minara qinee ani aqurara ufa ameemaanai quqaidaqa. Anee sia kaifaa maqaki narana ummaqusaida neennaranoo.
Anee narana ummaqusainanoo maqa fannoo sia ani narana amiannoo. Minara anee maaqa siainafa maridana aiku quqirafa maaqa maaqa kaqi ninnaranoo.
Kainafa minara iriseenoo Anutuna qimaminoo qinau. Anee qummaara firaana qini qimiananoo sia qinee amana uqeeraanaura.
Qinee maa maqanasaa ani afusaa marunnana anee diqiqaanaqa qinee qiku quqirausa aiqamatinai nuanaura. Qinee maaqanna maaqanna dapikiqa nuananoo yafee qini qiqafainafa mifa kuqa daruannoo.

Karaambaiqa minara iriseenoo qimaminoo qinau. Sia miqifara, faiqí moo fannoo yafee ani arinnana qinee mina akiiqara dinni taikasee dinni ani qaaraqanda marasee naruanaura. Miqi qimaseenoo karaambaiqa Kaina afaaqasaa sia aruaqee akara quqanau.
Miqooqari Kainafa Anutuna oorisaaqari finoo Eedeena kadida aaqaqari suani oosana qaannai moo maqa maaqai mina auqu niku quqirausa nua maqusa fee qimarunnai finau.
Kainana aiku asauku nuqu.

Miqoo oonureenoo Kainafa narí anaaqa faqa faiqi moo akoonaiqi maqaseenoo mina auqu Eenookanee qinau. Kainafa narí anaaqa faiqi maqoo kari maqusa moo auquseenoo mi maqusana auqu narí amaaku amaranaikinoo Eenooka maqusa fee qinau.

Eenookafa faiqí kammafinoo akoonaiqi Iradana maqanau. Iradafa faiqí kammafinoo akoonaiqi Meequyaeerana maqanau. Meequyaeerafa faiqí kammafinoo akoonaiqi Metusaeerana maqanau. Metusaeerafa faiqí kammafinoo akoonaiqi Rameekana maqanau.

Rameekafa faiqí kammafinoo qaara anaasee maranau, moona auqu Adaa nammarifa moona auqu Siraa nammarifa mariqau. (Adaa nammarina auqu oosana amiqira fee qimaqoofa marinau. Siraa nammarina auqu oosana auqaana fee qimaqoofa marinau.)
Indaaruqaa anaasee auqu Adaa nammarifa faiqi moo Yabarana maqasoofanoo findifinoo aandau apatannai uiqaana maqa usakasaida nimarusa nikoofa marinau.
Yabarafa firimaru aandausasaa rakisi marusa nikoofa marinau. Yabarana akaqa Yubarafa marinau. Mifa findifinoo qufireena fuaqee marusa faqa piripunna arimarusa faqa nikoofa marinau.

Rameekana inaaqiana anaasee moo Siraa nammarifa marinau. Mifa akoonaiqi Tubarakaina maqasoofanoo findifinoo koopaannai faqa qainnannai faqa ainaina auqimarufa marinau. Tubarakainana auna auqu Naammaa nammarifa marinau.
Rameekafa narí aanaaqaqara maaqi qimasee qimanniminau.

content.text: Adaa nammarisa Siraa nammarisa qini ufa iriaqa,
Qinee Rameekausa qini qinaaqaqara ufa qianaqa amiqimmasee iriaqa.
Faiqí moo fannoo kaakadi darifaqa qinee mina kuqamma ariqa.
Asauku samu qini darina akiiqara mi kumaaraana kuqamma ariqa.
Moo fannoo Kainana arinnana akiiaqara Anutufa dinni taikasee dinni ani qaara marasee 7 fasiqa naruannoo. Moo fannoo qini Rameekausa darinnana akiiaqara Anutufa fiqaramasee 77 fasiqa naruannoo.

content: Seetana aiku asauku nuqu.

Adamafa kaifaa narí anaaqa faiqi mara amisoofanoo amuaqu qaikinoo akoonaiqi moo maqaseenoo mina auqu Seetanee qinau. Miqi qimaseenoo mina anoofa qinau. Anutufa qini qimaaku moo qiminoo narí afasaana Abeerana amaaqa maqaanifeera qiminoo mifa Kainafa aruna amaaqa maqaannoo.
Seetafa innooqafinoo akoonaiqi Eenoosana maqanau. Eenoosafa maru kamuqooqari oosana arasee misa Anutunara innaaru qidaqa minara naaqura Karaambaiqee Yaawee fee qidaqa innaaru qimariqau.
